asr.full_text: The Earth is a very simple planet. The planet earth, 7.3 billion persons are all in the same needs, no matter who you are There is one thing we all have in common, where you live in the world, We all need food, water, clothes and shelter and wherever you are you must pay for it. The common denominator of humanity is money! Money creates a feeling of security, it shows us a way to fulfill our dreams and therefore most of us end us spend most of their lives trying to earn money, to pay bills, to earn a living, and to meet their needs Money does not only help us realize our dreams it is also a means of destruction and some associate it withiness, lies and crime. Money is more or less the champion of the good and the bad and for many it remains a mystery. It is the truth that now the common fores are saved by nothing but our own esteem. CFPIs worldwide hold our future in their hands and are not ready to give up. Money means power and this information can really reinforce if you are willing to be open-minded and learn the truth about money. The financial crisis of 2008 almost destroyed the world's financial system. Central banks and other regulatory bodies assume the responsibility of having misled the crisis. Many people and companies have gone bankrupt over the night. But, at the same time, many possibilities have arisen for sure. We are always facing a piece of paper and, after centuries of economic challenges, we are about to discover that there are better ways. The result of the 2008 crisis is the appearance of one of the biggest financial opportunities that contest the entire monetary system in a simple heartbeat. It was created and born years of frustration and distrust towards the banking and monetary system. It was created and born after years of frustration and distrust of the banking and monetary system. The cryptocurrency, is a fact. What is the cryptocurrency ? The Bitcoin blockchain chain was written in 2008 and despite criticism from regulation authorities the financial sector, institutions, governments and media, it had huge rise in value. Only between 2009 and 2013 the value of a coin turned from 0,1 USD to more than $ 1,100. The people who had invested in Bitcoin have become multi-millionaires in a very short time, and it is probably one of the greatest financialatable economic successes in the record record in the history of finance. One of them was a young Norwegian who invested only $ 26 to forget his existence. A few years later, his modest investment of $ 26 had turned into more than 850,000 American dollars. There was a cost-efficient lesson given to anyone who had been introduced with Bitcoin at an early stage, but had let it go. What to do if the new technology allows everyone in the world to be their own bank, free of taxes and interest? Crypto money is built around mathematics, a technological computer software with shared code which connects a global network over the Internet. is built out of mathematics. A computer software technological with a shared code connecting a global network by the internet. But how do you know could we trust her ? Traditionally, we are programmed to trust third parties such as banks, credit card companies and fundraising services as they ensure follow-up of the money by transfer from one to the other and we pay a lot for that. We have the habit to pay the payment of money by transfers from one to the other and we pay a lot for that. We are used to pay a lot of money for something that could be free. Most fiducious banks think they are solid, honest and reliable but if there were means that can delete its intermediaries and its enormous charge, amounts that are less expensive safer and faster while many people associate themselves with anonymous black market, they are far from being transparent. Take a look at today's report, we easily copied and downloaded music or movies on the internet. Cryptocurrency is similar to digital music and movies on the internet ! Listen carefully. Here is the key for understand these crypto currencies. Could you know with confidence that your digital money will not be downloaded as easily as your favorite songs? How a digital currency may keep its value and not be copied online? The interesting thing is that the crypto currency is not a file on a computer.

textual.observation: The title presents Onecoin as “the future of Cryptocurrency,” while the description provides a registration link for the audience.

evidence.quote: Onecoin the future of Cryptocurrency to see

textual.context: Promotional framing is suggested by the title and registration-link description; the supplied records do not establish whether the link is official or what registration entails.
textual.potential_relevance: An endorsement claim is directly paired with a request to use a registration destination, creating an endorsement-to-registration relationship for later context assessment.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish official affiliation, fees, required information, payment or transfer steps, promised benefits, transaction outcomes, or destination legitimacy.

visual.observation: A news-style webpage displays a headline reporting that a Norwegian man forgot about a $26 Bitcoin investment and later made $850,000.
visual.context: Visible reporting/news-page context; no direct offer or instruction to viewers is shown.
visual.potential_relevance: The unusually large return claim is explicitly linked to a Bitcoin investment, creating a notable investment-outcome relationship that may merit review.
visual.limitations: The sampled frame does not establish whether the claim is accurate, whether viewers are being asked to invest or transfer funds, or whether any promotion is involved.

textual_context_notes.observation: The high-return examples in the ASR are attributed to Bitcoin rather than explicitly to Onecoin.

evidence.quote: The people who had invested in Bitcoin have become multi-millionaires in a very short time

visual_context_notes.observation: The Bitcoin return claim appears within a webpage formatted as a news article.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because its title promotes OneCoin as the future of cryptocurrency and its description gives a direct OneCoin registration link. The narration uses Bitcoin's dramatic past appreciation as a comparison while inviting viewers toward OneCoin, which the U.S. Department of Justice documented as a fraudulent cryptocurrency-selling operation. The quoted $26-to-$850,000 story concerns Bitcoin, not an observed OneCoin payout.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S05 fits the OneCoin registration and implied token-appreciation appeal. The Bitcoin anecdote is comparative advertising, not proof that OneCoin generated such returns.
